title: February Demonstration Artists – Bill Lane (Watercolor)
paragraphs: Guild of Harwich February 15 General Meeting & Artist Demonstration
The Guild’s Saturday, February 15, General Meeting will feature Bill Lane demonstrating painting with watercolor. Bill’s website: https://www.billlanewatercolors.com/

Our business meeting will start at 1:30pm with artist demonstration at 2:00-3:45pm at the Harwich Community Center in the Multi-Purpose Room. The meeting and demonstration is free and open to the public. You will be warmly welcomed by our supportive community whether you are aspiring artist or accomplished painter, or just enjoy art!
Bill’s numerous memberships include Copley Society of art, Boston, New England Watercolor Society, American Watercolor Society, and the National Watercolor Society.

Bill Lane, is an accomplished watercolorist who notes that “the everyday scenes intrigue me the most; be it a barren landscape, boats in the harbor or city life on a busy day. I observe how the light plays into the scene and reflects off the subjects. I work to capture that light while enhancing my point-of-interest in the painting.”

bodyHtml:
Michael Rudden January 29, 2025

Guild of Harwich February 15 General Meeting & Artist Demonstration

The Guild’s Saturday, February 15, General Meeting will feature Bill Lane demonstrating painting with watercolor. Bill’s website: https://www.billlanewatercolors.com/

Our business meeting will start at 1:30pm with artist demonstration at 2:00-3:45pm at the Harwich Community Center in the Multi-Purpose Room. The meeting and demonstration is free and open to the public.  You will be warmly welcomed by our supportive community whether you are aspiring artist or accomplished painter, or just enjoy art!

Bill’s numerous memberships include Copley Society of art, Boston, New England Watercolor Society, American Watercolor Society, and the National Watercolor Society.

Bill Lane, is an accomplished watercolorist who notes that “the everyday scenes intrigue me the most; be it a barren landscape, boats in the harbor or city life on a busy day. I observe how the light plays into the scene and reflects off the subjects. I work to capture that light while enhancing my point-of-interest in the painting.”
